title: fix: build KPI retention cohorts from each user's first request
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Fixed the KPI weekly retention table to group users by their first regular request, using `user_first_activity_mv` for the last eight finished UTC weeks instead of their first request within the reporting window. Weeks that have not ended now return null and display as “—”; W1 no longer counts the unfinished current week. Requests rejected for insufficient Pollen (402) still count, and the caption now says so. Restricting the activity scan to cohort users reduced the query from 10.4 GB and 7.8 s to 4.5 GB and about 2.8 s; the previous query had hit the 20 s timeout. For the 2026-08-10 cohort, the corrected count is 2,799 users with 16.4% W1 retention, versus 2,122 and 77% before. Production-data checks matched first-request dates for all 26,354 users and independently recomputed W1–W4 counts. Output columns and the `/retention` 30-minute cache are unchanged.
